restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1 only (eight partial rounds 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

time_log2 is the worst-case operation count of the algorithm of proof.md section 4 (one centre, K = 1, the trial charged in full with stage D for every remainder sequence and the root isolation at its cap of 64 rounds, one thread), plus the offline bound of 1,000,000 operations of section 6.2, declared as preprocessing_log2 = 20 and inside time_log2; memory_log2_bytes is the footprint. This entry is our filed r = 8 one-centre entry c69ae3de with one change: stage C (S^((p-1)/2) mod g) runs in the value domain on K = 182 cosets of size h = 2^24 of the order-h subgroup (bradcush 4bcabff8; section 4.3V, Appendix E), stage C row 446,444,428,530,905 operations; rows B (-186) and plan_invN misses (-3,089) change with it, other rows unchanged. N_max = 1,527,039,469,464,147 operations (section 6.1). Memory 602,370,547,468 bytes (section 7), memory_log2_bytes = 39.132. Cost model orchard-field-ram-v2: every field operation, load, store, control operation and random word is priced 1/C, C = 216 + 21 r = 384.

success_probability 0.39009 is a probability over the algorithm's fresh independent uniform 256-bit random words (the cost model's random-word primitive) for the fixed target, derived from the one score-critical premise H-ONE as 1 - (1 - q)^K - K (eps_coin + eps_iso + eps_O1) = q - eps_coin - eps_iso - eps_O1 with K = 1 and q = 0.3901 (proof.md sections 9.1, 9.2; eps_O1 < 2^-189 bounds the probability that g_c has a root on the evaluation set O1, proof.md 4.3V(d)). The value-domain stage C computes R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g exactly: proved in proof.md 4.3V(d) from three directly verified facts (h | p - 1, the 2K cosets are distinct, n1 >= m + 1), so the premise, the success bound and stage D are unchanged.

heuristics.statement: As the heuristic H-ONE of our filed r = 8 one-centre entry c69ae3de (unchanged): the number of centres c in F_p with 1 <= k(c) <= 16 is at least 0.3901 p; with K = 1 the success bound is q - eps_coin - eps_iso - eps_O1 = 0.390099999999997628. The value-domain stage C of this entry changes only how R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g is computed (the coset powering of bradcush 4bcabff8), not R itself (proved, proof.md 4.3V(d)), so H-ONE, its role, scope, extrapolation, evidence and limitations are identical to c69ae3de.
heuristics.scope: The fixed Poseidon target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1, this line construction, centres uniform on F_p. Not claimed for other round counts. Stage D is charged for every remainder sequence (proof.md 6.3), so no premise on the sequences is used; the value-domain stage C is a program change under the declared cost model, not a heuristic.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the law of k(c) at reduced depth to the polynomial F of depth 12. The roots of G(c,t) in t are +-t_1, ..., +-t_m, so the monodromy group of the cover lies in the hyperoctahedral group B_m and k(c) counts the positive fixed points of the Frobenius element; for the full group B_m this number is Poisson(1/2) in the limit, P(k >= 1) = 1 - e^(-1/2) = 0.3934693 (exactly 1 - sum_{j<=m} (-1/2)^j/j!), and Bonferroni at order 4 gives P >= 151/384 = 0.3932292 from four moments (proof.md 9.3(a), (b)). At N = 2 and 3 S-box layers on the deployed constants and the attack line the arithmetic monodromy is B_12 and B_62 (Grok jobs 136 and 137, re-run on the deployed constants, proof.md 10.3); the geometric monodromy then contains the commutator subgroup of B_m, the j-fold fibre powers are absolutely irreducible, and the Aubry-Perret bound with Bonferroni gives 0.39346933 <= P(1 <= k <= 16) <= 0.39346944 there: the premise is a theorem at those depths (proof.md 9.3(c)). Measured: toy fields at p = 1,048,627, exact over all centres, 27 cases with 3 to 8 layers, P(k >= 1) between 0.39214 and 0.39436 (proof.md 9.3(d)); the organizer-run tests one-centre-n2-t256 and one-centre-n3-t24 run one trial of the algorithm at depth N = 2, 3 (m = 12, 62) per organizer seed and return a witness pair exactly when the sequence is normal, 1 <= k(c) <= 16 and the isolated root gives a verified collision of F_N, with predicted counts Binomial(T, 0.393469) (proof.md 10.5.1). The deviations from the law shrink like p^(-1/2) and do not grow with the degree (toy fields 1.36/sqrt(p); the counts of Grok job 139, eps ~ 3.1/sqrt(p) over degrees 5 to 1,953,125); the premise extrapolates the law to N = 14 with an allowance of 0.0034.
heuristics.limitations: As c69ae3de. The value-domain stage C adds no premise: the 2K cosets 5^0 H, ..., 5^(2K-1) H are distinct because 5^(d h) != 1 for 1 <= d <= 2K - 1 = 363 (checked directly), h = 2^24 divides p - 1 and n1 = K h >= m + 1 (proof.md 4.3V(a)), and from these three facts the equality of the value-domain R and the coefficient-domain S^((p-1)/2) mod g is proved (4.3V(d)); the cost of the stage is a finite count (4.3V(e), Appendix E), not a premise.
